exceptions.rationale: Trivy reports fix_deferred with no fixed Debian package. The finding is specific to an OpenSSL QUIC server/listener accepting QUIC Initial packets; the production NestJS API is a TCP HTTP service on port 3001 behind the existing reverse proxy and contains no QUIC, HTTP/3 or UDP server wiring. The exception is finding-specific, scanner-specific, time-bounded to seven days, and does not relax CRITICAL or unrelated HIGH findings.

Trivy reports fix_deferred with no fixed Debian package. The finding is specific to an OpenSSL QUIC server/listener accepting QUIC Initial packets; the production Next.js Web runtime is a TCP HTTP service on port 3000 behind the existing reverse proxy and contains no QUIC, HTTP/3 or UDP server wiring. The exception is finding-specific, scanner-specific, time-bounded to the same short window as the API exception, and does not relax CRITICAL or unrelated HIGH findings.

Trivy reports fix_deferred with no fixed Debian package. The finding is specific to an OpenSSL QUIC server/listener accepting QUIC Initial packets; the durable outbox worker is an outbound PostgreSQL/Kafka process whose optional health endpoint is TCP HTTP on port 3002 and contains no QUIC, HTTP/3 or UDP server wiring. The exception is finding-specific, scanner-specific, time-bounded to the same short window as the API and Web exceptions, and does not relax CRITICAL or unrelated HIGH findings.
